You can play this game online with family and friends, but you do NOT need them in order to be able to play. You can easily play alone offline or include 1, 2 or 3 other persons online and choose to involve one or more of the robot players, that comes with the app. The abilities and temperament of the robot players are unique, so just like with humans, you will discover that some are quite talented and others are not. Luminosus is a unique and challenging puzzle game that combines the fun of matching colors on a Tetris-esque board. 
Puzzle pieces can be changed back and forth as many times as you want, so a red block will change a yellow piece orange but another red piece will change it back to red. 
If a piece is influenced by all three colors it is turned white and scores significantly more when cleared.

In this way the game requires planning more steps ahead than your standard piece-dropping puzzle game.
